content:
Marta: FYI nightly eval flagged a weird delta on rwi-7b-int4. Looks concentrated on two cohorts: legal-snippets and summarization-short.
Zack: saw the alert, thanks. severity appears medium from the dashboard. link: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/3456 :eyes:
ci-bot: nightly-eval job #4872 completed — 5 suites failed, 12 tests regressed.
Marta: baseline fp16 shows no regression, so likely quant-specific. baseline vs quant4 diffs: ROUGE-L -11.8, exact-match down ~9%.
Priya: I'm taking initial ownership. pinging @zack for infra logs and @marta for eval artifacts.
Zack: sending logs now, attaching the truncated failure sample.
Zack: ```
Prompt: "Summarize the following contract clause in plain English:"
Input: "The party A hereby indemnifies party B against any and all claims arising from..."
FP16 output: "Party A agrees to protect Party B from claims related to..."
INT4 output: ""
```
Marta: interesting — INT4 returned empty string for the summarization prompt. also seeing garbled token sequences in legal-snippets (lots of <unk>/<mask> tokens).
Priya: initial hypothesis: tokenization or bpe mismatch after quant conversion, or KV cache misalignment for short prompts. will try local reproduce with quantized artifact.
oncall-ml: assigned @priya as owner (P-rotate). please post next update in 30m.
oncall-ml: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/nightly-eval-triage
Priya: repro steps I'm running:
1) pull rwi-7b-int4 artifact from s3: s3://redwood-models/rwi-7b/int4/2026-02-17
2) run eval harness with seed=42 and --short-prompts
3) compare tokenization between fp16 and int4 artifacts
Priya: quick first check: token counts differ by 1-3 tokens for ~60% of failing prompts. suspect padding/tokenizer config drift.
Marta: good catch. any recent changes to tokenizer registry or model conversion pipeline?
Zack: build logs show conversion script used tokenizer v0.9.1 while baseline used v0.9.4. that mismatch could explain it.
Priya: will attempt a conversion with v0.9.4 and re-run. if that fixes, we treat this as conversion/config bug not model quality regression.
Marta: severity set to P2 for now. if we see more suites failing or customer impact, escalate.
Priya: update in ~40m or sooner if repro complete. :thumbsup:
Zack: added a short trace to the incident: https://logs.redwood.ai/trace/4872/short
ci-bot: evidence bundle uploaded to artifacts/nightly/4872.zip
Priya: quick note — when I force tokenizer v0.9.4 during conversion, INT4 reproductions now emit non-empty summaries and ROUGE-L delta drops to -1.2. pushing more runs.
Marta: great. keep this thread for handoff, and if confirmed we'll patch conversion pipeline and re-run full nightly.
Zack: I'll prep a rollback of the conversion job and a follow-up PR to pin tokenizer version in the pipeline.
Priya: posting final when full suite done.
Marta: thanks — tagging for visibility @oncall-ml and @eng-ml. :white_check_mark:
